### 'I’ve Lost My Taste for God’s Word': Bad Reasons We Neglect the Bible
Author: Greg Morse
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/ive-lost-my-taste-for-gods-word
Passage: Malachi 1:6
Points:
- Lukewarm believers often treat God casually and neglect Scripture due to worldliness and spiritual distraction.
- God challenges complacent hearts by demanding where His rightful filial honor and reverence have gone.
- Offering sleepy, half-hearted leftovers in private devotions parallels the ancient priests bringing defective sacrifices.
- Approaching the Almighty requires genuine reverence and awakened awe rather than bored, careless routine.

### Will Graham Devotion: Complacent Christians
Author: Will Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/articles/will-graham-devotion-complacent-christians
Passage: Malachi 1:6-14
Points:
- Complacency fosters spiritual pollution, causing believers to offer God disrespectful cast-offs and divided devotion.
- Presenting flawed, blemished service is unacceptable to God and renders worship unfit in His sight.
- Treating sacred service as an unwelcome burden exposes a dangerous heart condition of apathy and boredom.
- Escaping spiritual complacency requires assessing personal spiritual health, confessing sin, and cultivating intentional fervor.
